items.problem: Migrated Package.appxmanifest carried over the UWP windows.dialProtocol <uap:Extension>, which cannot register for a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app; the package never registers and the app never launches (all 6 scenarios fail, score 0).
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_launch_status (AppxManifest.xml(35,10) 0x80070032 / windows.dialProtocol extension 'The request is not supported' 0x80073CF6); migrated manifest L27-29.
items.root_cause: The manifest checklist treated <uap:Extension> as safe to copy; some UWP app-model extensions are not registrable under the packaged WinUI 3 desktop model and abort the whole package registration.
items.change: Added a static manifest lint to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 Section 5b that FAILs when Package.appxmanifest still declares a known-unregisterable UWP extension (windows.dialProtocol, windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer), with a fix pointing to remove the block. Paired with a MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md checklist item (Tier 3) instructing the agent to strip unsupported UWP <Extensions> and correcting the prior 'carry over <uap:Extension>' guidance.
items.expected_effect: On re-run, the validator FAILs on a carried-over dialProtocol extension before the agent can declare done; the agent removes it and the app registers and launches.
items.falsifiable_check: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 prints '[FAIL] ... UWP-only extension windows.dialProtocol ...' for a manifest containing it; after removal the app registers (Test-AppLaunch status=running) and the 6 scenarios become reachable.

items.problem: The launch/validator tooling reported the package-registration failure as a benign environment WARN and returned overall PASS, so the agent shipped a non-launching app as 'done'.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~L9145: '[WARN] Smoke launch ... not a migration defect ... ==> Validate-UwpMigration: PASS'.
items.root_cause: Test-AppLaunch.ps1's no-AUMID branch hard-coded 'no registration => environment problem' even when winapp's error string was a manifest-content registration failure (a real migration defect).
items.change: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 now inspects the winapp error string in the no-AUMID branch: if it matches a manifest-registration signature (AppxManifest.xml( / 0x80073CF6 / 'extension ... is not supported' / 'registering the <x> extension'), it classifies the result as a defect (status='crashed', anchor='manifest') instead of 'unavailable'. Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 already maps 'crashed' -> [FAIL].
items.expected_effect: A manifest-defect launch failure now FAILs the validator instead of WARN+PASS, so the agent cannot declare done on a non-registering app.
items.falsifiable_check: Given a manifest-registration error, Test-AppLaunch.ps1 -Json returns status='crashed' (not 'unavailable'); Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 returns a FAIL instead of PASS.
